title: Compliance Auditing & Monitoring Analyst
description:
**Bring more to life.**

  

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

  

Within Danaher the work our Life Science businesses do saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact. And at Pall Corporation, one of Danaher’s 15\+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

  

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

  

We have over 21,000 associates across more than 10 life sciences businesses. These businesses empower our customers to develop diverse and impactful innovations — from investigating the causes of disease, creating therapies and vaccines, protecting fluid filtration on airplanes, testing food and water, to advancing pharmaceuticals and biopharmaceuticals.  



  

As a global leader in high\-tech filtration, separation, and purification, Pall Corporation thrives on helping our customers solve their toughest challenges. Our products serve diverse, global customer needs across a wide range of applications to advance health, safety and environmentally responsible technologies. From airplane engines to hydraulic systems, scotch to smartphones, OLED screens to paper—everyday Pall is there, helping protect critical operating assets, improve product quality, minimize emissions and waste, and safeguard health. For the exponentially curious, Pall is a place where you can thrive and amplify your impact on the world. Find what drives you on a team with a more than 75\-year history of discovery, determination, and innovation.

  

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

  

The Compliance Auditing \& Monitoring Analyst role supports the execution and continuous improvement of Life Sciences compliance monitoring programs, with a focus on Anti\-Bribery and Anti\-Corruption (ABAC) and Healthcare Compliance (HCC). The role helps evaluate key compliance controls, conduct monitoring and testing activities, support third\-party and channel partner reviews, document observations, and track remediation efforts to strengthen the effectiveness of the compliance program.

  

This position reports to the Sr. Manager, Compliance Monitoring and Data Analytics and is part of the Compliance team located in India and will be fully remote.

 **In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**

* Support execution of the annual ABAC and/or HCC Auditing \& Monitoring plan by performing foundational auditing and monitoring procedures across defined risk areas, including review of transactions, third\-party and channel partner support, documentation testing, and control validation, while escalating issues and questions through established compliance review channels
* Support the execution of third\-party risk management program desk review and onsite audit activities by gathering and reviewing required documentation, assessing completeness against established desk review and onsite audit criteria, identifying gaps for follow\-up, and helping document observations, remediation actions, and status updates.
* Track remediation activities and support follow\-up validation by coordinating with OpCo stakeholders to confirm timely completion, evidence submission, and effectiveness of corrective actions.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of all Compliance\-related processes and leverage data analytics, dashboards, AI\-enabled tools, and automation solutions to identify trends, support monitoring activities, improve testing efficiency, and provide actionable compliance insights while operating within company governance requirements.

 **The essential requirements of the job include**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Law, Business Administration or a related discipline from a recognized institution.
* 6\+ years of experience in compliance, audit monitoring, risk, or another relevant function in a regulated environment.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze information, review documentation for completeness and consistency, maintain accurate records, and communicate findings clearly in written and verbal form.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams with attention to detail, follow established methodologies, meet deadlines, and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional stakeholders across geographies.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel and PowerPoint, comfort learning compliance systems, data tools, AI\-enabled solutions, and workflow automation platforms used to enhance Compliance A\&M execution.
* Very good communication (English \- Speaking and Writing)

 **Travel, Motor Vehicle Record \& Physical/Environment Requirements:** *if applicable for role*

* Ability to travel 15% \- Domestic and International

  



**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

* Exposure to ABAC compliance, third\-party due diligence, Channel Partner oversight, or monitoring and testing activities through academic work, certifications, or internships.
* Relevant certifications or progress toward certification, such as CPA, CRMA, CFE, CIA, or similar credentials.
* Working experience in Global Organisation with matrix strcture

  

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real\-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.


For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

title: Discovery Specialist
description:
**Job Family Group:**

Legal Group  

  

**Job Description:**

bp Legal is seeking an experienced Discovery Specialist to provide discovery support to bp's Legal team. This position would provide support to Litigation, Disputes, and Regulatory Case Teams for legal matters and investigations globally. This role is part of bp’s Legal and E\&C Solutions and Innovation Discovery Team and works closely with the Head of Discovery Services, Project Managers/Paralegals, Discovery Specialists, IT as well as internal counsel, external counsel and bp’s preferred providers.


The ideal candidate is team and detail oriented and brings to the position outstanding interpersonal skills, communication skills (both oral and written), technical skills and sound judgment. The candidate has experience working in the electronic discovery or Information Technology related field, preferably with energy company litigation experience. This role works a hybrid schedule directed by management.

  

  

Key Accountabilities:

  

  

* Collection of electronically stored information from various data sources.
* Understand implications of international collection and data privacy regulations and consult with appropriate parties on international data issues.
* Liaise with bp IT on data preservation activities and acquire approval, access and collect data from various applications/systems.
* Coordinating and tracking all electronic collection activities and maintaining chain of custody documentation.
* Creating data manifest, updating collection tracking log, and ensuring successful transfer of data for each shipment of collected data to processing vendor.
* Understanding bp’s standard discovery practices and assisting the bp Paralegal Project Managers and bp Attorneys throughout various discovery phases including discovery planning, legal hold, collection, processing, production, and ongoing case management.
* Collaborate with case teams and provide technical support and guidance.
  

  

Education:

  

  

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent years of experience

  

  

Essential Experience and Job Requirement:

  

  

* 3 to 4 years’ experience in the eDiscovery area with a company or eDiscovery/IT group or with an eDiscovery vendor.
* Experience working within a range of technologies and key business functions in the Litigation and Discovery sector.
* Experience using Purview eDiscovery to perform Microsoft 365 electronic data collections is preferred
* Experience with Relativity, Brainspace, Legal Hold systems and other widely used eDiscovery applications is preferred.
  

  

Experience developing automation, reporting, and workflow optimization solutions using one or more of the following technologies is preferred:


* PowerShell
* Kusto Query Language (KQL)
* SQL
* Python
* Microsoft Graph API and JSON
  

  

Desirable Criteria:

  

  

* Strong problem solving, scripting and analytical skills.
* Experience in AI domain and tools.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Ability to work optimally in a busy time\-sensitive environment while maintaining professionalism and strong interpersonal skills.
* Prior project management experience in large, complex electronic discovery projects.
* Holds or will obtain a current passport to travel internationally as needed.
* Member of a technical or professional body that has confirmed an individual has reached a level of capability within a technical or professional field or formal certification that they can undertake specialist work or processes (e.g., CEDS, RCA, PMI etc.) is desired.
  

  

**Join our Team and advance your career as Discovery Specialist!**
